text: Two signed requirements now exist. That creates real pressure to build both at once -- this is where we draw a hard line instead.
V1 ships the Bronze, Silver, and Gold lakehouse on Databricks and Delta, plus Operations' Fabric report. The real-time Eventhouse feed for Support is sequenced right after, not built in parallel.
That order isn't arbitrary -- the real-time feed depends directly on the deduplication and ordering logic the lakehouse build proves out first.
Predictive ETA, driver scorecards, and a public tracking page all get logged as deferred, not quietly dropped.
Next: the first real architecture decision -- why this needs Databricks, Fabric, and Kafka together, not one bigger warehouse.
